8206.title: Unread attention lost during sidebar activity
8206.rootCauseOneLine: The shared resolver prioritizes runtime over unread success, and plugin row status replaces the unread glyph; the title has no separate unread styling.
8206.proposedFix: Agree a separate unread-attention signal alongside activity rather than swapping the existing priority order. Decide root-versus-child attention semantics first, then share the signal across the SDK resolver, glyph renderer, and thread-list title, preserving error/input precedence and one-glyph layout.
8206.caveats: Synthetic inputs exercise the real resolver and real React glyph renderer, not a live provider or the reporter's machine. The originating plugin is unknown. Browser screenshot capture was unavailable because this host has no Chrome/Chromium; the images are genuine production-rendered SVG glyphs, not full-sidebar screenshots. Child unread suppression is already explicit policy, not a newly discovered regression.
